account_check_status: Balance of the applicant's checking account at the time of application.
duration_in_month: Loan parameter: duration of the requested credit / repayment term, expressed in months.
credit_history: Applicant's prior credit-repayment record, encoding the standing and timeliness of any previous credit obligations.
purpose: Stated reason the credit is being requested (e.g. car, household goods, education, business, etc.).
credit_amount: Loan parameter: principal amount of credit requested.
savings: Balance of the applicant's savings account or bonds.
present_emp_since: Length of time the applicant has held their current job.
installment_as_income_perc: Installment rate as a percentage of the applicant's disposable income.
personal_status_sex: Combined marital status and sex of the applicant.
other_debtors: Whether a third party is jointly responsible for the loan: 'none', 'co-applicant', or 'guarantor'.
present_res_since: Length of time the applicant has lived at their current address.
property: Most valuable type of property the applicant owns.
age: Age of the applicant, in years.
other_installment_plans: Other installment-plan credit obligations the applicant holds outside this loan: 'bank', 'stores', or 'none'.
housing: Applicant's current housing situation: 'own', 'rent', or 'for free' (rent-free, e.g. with family or employer-provided).
credits_this_bank: Number of existing credits the applicant currently holds at this bank, including the one being applied for.
job: Type and qualification level of the applicant's employment, ranging from unemployed/unskilled to management/highly qualified.
people_under_maintenance: Number of people the applicant is financially liable to provide maintenance for (dependants).
telephone: Whether a telephone is registered under the applicant's name at their address.
foreign_worker: Whether the applicant is a foreign worker.
